title: Nikita and game
statementMd:
Nikita plays a new computer game. There are $*m*$ levels in this game. In the beginning of each level a new class appears in the game; this class is a child-class of the class $*y*_{*i*}$ (and $*y*_{*i*}$ is called parent-class for this new class). Thus, the classes form a tree. Initially there is only one class with index $1$.

Changing the class to its neighbour (child-class or parent-class) in the tree costs $1$ coin. You can not change the class back. The cost of changing the class $*a*$ to the class $*b*$ is equal to the total cost of class changes on the path from $*a*$ to $*b*$ in the class tree.

Suppose that at $*i*$ -th level the maximum cost of changing one class to another is $*x*$. For each level output the number of classes such that for each of these classes there exists some other class $*y*$, and the distance from this class to $*y*$ is exactly $*x*$.

## Input

First line contains one integer number $*m*$ — number of queries ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 3·10^{5}$).

Next $*m*$ lines contain description of queries. $*i*$ -th line ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$) describes the $*i*$ -th level and contains an integer $*y*_{*i*}$ — the index of the parent-class of class with index $*i* + 1$ ($1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$).

## Output

Suppose that at $*i*$ -th level the maximum cost of changing one class to another is $*x*$. For each level output the number of classes such that for each of these classes there exists some other class $*y*$, and the distance from this class to $*y*$ is exactly $*x*$.
statementZhMd:
Nikita 在玩一款新的电脑游戏。这款游戏中有 $*m*$ 个关卡。在每个关卡开始时，游戏中会出现一个新的类别；这个类别是类别 $*y*_{*i*}$ 的子类别（$*y*_{*i*}$ 被称为这个新类别的父类别）。因此，这些类别构成一棵树。初始时只有一个编号为 $1$ 的类别。

在树中将类别切换到其相邻类别（子类别或父类别）需要花费 $1$ 枚硬币。你不能将类别切换回去。将类别 $*a*$ 切换到类别 $*b*$ 的花费，等于类别树中从 $*a*$ 到 $*b*$ 的路径上所有类别切换的总花费。

假设在第 $*i*$ 个关卡中，将一个类别切换到另一个类别的最大花费为 $*x*$。对于每个关卡，输出满足以下条件的类别数量：对于每个这样的类别，都存在某个其他类别 $*y*$，使得该类别到 $*y*$ 的距离恰好为 $*x*$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*m*$——查询数量（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 3·10^{5}$）。

接下来 $*m*$ 行描述查询。第 $*i*$ 行（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$）描述第 $*i*$ 个关卡，并包含一个整数 $*y*_{*i*}$——编号为 $*i* + 1$ 的类别的父类别编号（$1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$）。

## 输出格式

假设在第 $*i*$ 个关卡中，将一个类别切换到另一个类别的最大花费为 $*x*$。对于每个关卡，输出满足以下条件的类别数量：对于每个这样的类别，都存在某个其他类别 $*y*$，使得该类别到 $*y*$ 的距离恰好为 $*x*$。
